attribution.note: Marcus states and endorses the observation in his own words.

semantics.note: The proposition captures the historical assertion. November 2025 means through the statement date, November 19. The surrounding recommendation does not make this assertion conditional.

contract.note: Substantive national safeguards and a chamber floor vote are fair contextual readings. Marcus did not explicitly specify regulatory breadth or exclude committee votes, so these interpretations affect what counts.

evidence.note: The report predates the cutoff and explains regulatory scope. Its finding concerns enactment through June 2025, not floor votes through November 19.
The dated record supports absence of a floor vote for this candidate only. It cannot establish the absence of all qualifying votes, amendments, or provisions in larger bills.
Committee advancement challenges a broader reading denying substantive congressional action. It does not establish a floor vote under the contract.

reviews.rationale: The packet checks one relevant proposal but lacks a sufficiently complete review of qualifying floor votes through November 19, 2025. The enactment finding cannot establish absence of votes. Committee advancement does not contradict the fair floor-vote reading. Neither support nor contradiction is established.
